ConsentPage.CommonScopeText: Ability to perform all operations with data and use any functionality available for your account
ConsentPage.Footer1: You will be able to revoke access at any time in your user profile.
ConsentPage.Footer3: For the applications provided by Creatio, you can find the relevant documentation in the Academy. Note that Creatio does not review integrations with third-party applications. ConsentErrorInvalidRequest.Title: Integration setup error
ConsentErrorInvalidRequest.Message: Unable to start the authorization process because the request is not configured correctly. One or more required parameters are incorrect or missing.
ConsentErrorInvalidRequest.Suggestion: Contact your system administrator or Creatio support to verify the integration settings and ensure that all necessary parameters are provided.

ConsentErrorInvalidClient.Title: Integration not found
ConsentErrorInvalidClient.Message: Unable to start the authorization process because no active integration is configured using the provided client ID and authorized redirect URI.
ConsentErrorInvalidClient.Suggestion: Contact your system administrator or Creatio support to check the integration settings and ensure that the correct client ID and redirect URI are used.

ConsentErrorInvalidUser.Title: Access to integration is not permitted
ConsentErrorInvalidUser.Message: Unable to continue because your user account is not permitted to use this integration.
ConsentErrorInvalidUser.Suggestion: Contact your system administrator to update the list of users authorized to use this integration.

ConsentErrorInvalidConsentId.Title: Authorization request expired
ConsentErrorInvalidConsentId.Message: Unable to complete the authorization because the request has expired.
ConsentErrorInvalidConsentId.Suggestion: Restart the integration authorization process from the beginning to continue.

ConsentErrorServerError.Title: Error during integration setup
ConsentErrorServerError.Message: An error occurred while processing the request. Please try again later.
ConsentErrorServerError.Suggestion: Please contact your system administrator to request the necessary access rights and repeat your attempt after that.
